title: EngravingConfig
description: Maps glTF model nodes to dynamic text-engraving settings. One file is loaded per glTF asset; each entry in `nodes` binds a mesh node name to the UV channel and canvas layout used to rasterize user-supplied engraving text for that node.

nodes.description: One entry per engravable node. A node not listed here has no engraving support.

nodeName.description: Exact name of the mesh node in the glTF file (matched via Scene::get_node).

uvChannel.description: Index of the UV set dedicated to engraving, e.g. 1 for TEXCOORD_1 / vUv_1. Must be a channel not otherwise used by base-color/normal/etc. textures on this node's material.

aspectRatio.description: width / height of the engraving zone, e.g. 4.0 for a 1024x256 strip. Drives the offscreen canvas size (see EngravingCanvasManager::canvas_size_for).

maxCharacters.description: Upper bound on text length. Enforced by EngravingCanvasManager before rasterizing.

defaultFont.description: CSS font-family used when the caller doesn't pick one explicitly. Must also appear in allowedFonts.

allowedFonts.description: Whitelist of CSS font-family names selectable for this node. Each must be loadable via document.fonts (e.g. declared with @font-face or a web-safe font).

textureHeight.description: Height in pixels of the offscreen canvas / GPU texture. Width is derived as round(textureHeight * aspectRatio). Optional; defaults to 256.

padding.description: Fractional padding (of the shorter canvas dimension) kept empty around the text on every side during auto-scaling. Optional; defaults to 0.1 (10%).

engravingStrength.description: Intensity of the derivative-based normal perturbation at letter edges (bevel depth). Optional; defaults to 1.0.

engravingRoughness.description: Target PBR roughness inside the carved groove (matte laser-etched finish). Optional; defaults to 0.7.

engravingDarkening.description: Fraction by which the base albedo / specular color (f0) is darkened inside the groove, simulating micro-occlusion without altering hue. Optional; defaults to 0.35.

sizingMode.description: Text-sizing strategy. Optional; if omitted, resolves to HYBRID when both stripHeightMm and defaultFontSizeMm are present, otherwise RELATIVE. PHYSICAL/HYBRID require stripHeightMm and defaultFontSizeMm to also be set.

stripHeightMm.description: Physical height (mm) of the TEXCOORD_1 engraving strip on the real object. Required by PHYSICAL/HYBRID sizing.

defaultFontSizeMm.description: Target physical font height (mm) in PHYSICAL/HYBRID modes. Required alongside stripHeightMm.

minFontSizeMm.description: Smallest font height (mm) HYBRID mode may shrink to before overflowing text is rejected. Optional; must not exceed defaultFontSizeMm. If unset, HYBRID shrinks to fit the strip width with no floor.

fontSizeRatio.description: Fixed font height as a fraction of canvas height, used by RELATIVE mode when set. Optional; if unset, RELATIVE auto-fits the largest size that fits the padded bounds.

align.description: Horizontal text alignment within the padded strip. Optional; defaults to center.
